description: Extension methods for registering Tempo.Blazor services.

members.name: AddInMemoryNotifications
members.description: Replaces the default with so notifications are kept in memory. Also replaces with the same store so the badge count is live. Use this in demo / test applications where you want to see notifications without a real backend.

members.name: AddTempoBlazor
members.description: Registers the core Tempo.Blazor services shared by all component groups. ITmLocalizer: Singleton (stateless, thread-safe, backed by embedded JSON tables for en/cs/sk/fr) ThemeService: Scoped (per-circuit in Server mode, per-tab in WASM) ToastService: Scoped (per-circuit in Server mode, per-tab in WASM) DragDropService: Scoped drag/drop state shared by core components Add this call to your Blazor Program.cs: builder.Services.AddTempoBlazor(); To reword shipped translations in your application, register a decorator ITmLocalizer AFTER this call (it injects the built-in IStringLocalizer<TmResources> and overrides only the keys you list): builder.Services.AddTempoBlazor(); builder.Services.AddSingleton<ITmLocalizer, MyCustomTmLocalizer>(); To support e.g. Czech or Slovak localization, configure culture in Program.cs: var culture = new System.Globalization.CultureInfo("cs"); System.Globalization.CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentCulture = culture; System.Globalization.CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentUICulture = culture;
